  \caption[{Integral nonlinearity against code over five process corners, ladder on an ideal \SI{2.5}{\volt} rail,\,\dots}]{Integral nonlinearity against code over five process corners, ladder on an ideal \SI{2.5}{\volt} rail, \SI{25}{\celsius}, \texttt{reltol}~=~\num{1e-6}.
